Bantai, linear search vs binary search me kya farak hai?

Arey bhidu! Linear search bole toh gully ka ek ek ghar check karna — time complexity O(n). Aur binary search bole toh telephone directory — seedha aadha aadha divide karke O(log n) me nikal lena! Par yaad rakh bantai, binary search ke liye array pehle se sorted hona mangta hai!

SQL indexing kya hota hai aur kab lagana chahiye?

Dekh bhidu, bina index ke database table me search karna matlab Dadar station ke rush me dost ko dhundna — full table scan karna padega! Index lagaya toh book ke end me index page jaisa direct address mil jata hai (B-Tree structure). Par har jagah mat thokna, write operations (INSERT/UPDATE) slow ho jate hain bantai!

Docker container aur virtual machine me difference batao fast.

Ekdum simple bantai: VM bole toh poora alag flat lena (pura Guest OS, heavy resource), aur Docker container bole toh ek hi flat ke andar alag alag partitioned room (host kernel share karta hai, lightweight aur fast start). Container mast portable rehta hai bhidu!

Python me generator vs list comprehension me memory ka kya scene hai?

Arey bantai! List comprehension pura ka pura data ek saath memory me load karta hai, bada list hua toh RAM ka faluda ban jayega! Lekin generator `yield` use karke ek-ek item on-demand nikalta hai — O(1) memory. Ek number optimization technique hai boss!

Git rebase vs git merge me kya choose karu?

Dekh bhidu: `merge` safe rehta hai, history preserve karta hai par commit graph thoda jalebi ban jata hai. `rebase` linear clean history deta hai, par shared public branch pe rebase mara toh bawaal ho jayega! Local branch pe rebase, main/production pe merge — ye rule pakad ke chal.

JWT token kaha store karna chahiye frontend pe?

Khopdi me fit kar le bantai: `localStorage` me JWT rakha toh XSS attack me chori ho sakta hai! Best practice hai `httpOnly, secure, sameSite=strict` cookie me rakhna taaki JavaScript usko touch bhi na kar sake. Security first, tension zero!

Event loop JavaScript me kaise kaam karta hai?

Bantai, JS single threaded hai. Call stack me synchronous kaam fatfat niptata hai, asynchronous kaam (jaise setTimeout, fetch) Web APIs ko de deta hai. Jab stack khali hota hai, tab Event Loop callback queue aur microtask queue se utha ke stack me daalta hai. Microtasks (Promises) pehle entry maarte hain!

Bantai server down ho gaya, kya check karu?

Tension mat le bhidu! Step-by-step scene check kar: 1) Logs dekh `journalctl` ya Docker logs me, 2) Port listening check kar `netstat` ya `ss` se, 3) Memory aur CPU check kar `htop` se ki OOM killer ne process toh nahi uda diya, 4) Disk space `df -h` se dekh. Fatal error pakad me aa jayega bantai!
